ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates; Successors. All licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to any affiliate of Corio identified by written notice to Commerce One, provided that Corio remains responsible for such affiliate's compliance with the terms of this Agreement. Corio may transfer the licenses granted under this Section 2 to its successor in connection with the merger or acquisition of Corio or the sale of all or substantially all of its assets.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Section 2 grants run to Corio alone with no path to add our affiliates, so we have inserted a short subsection extending those licenses to affiliates we identify by written notice to Commerce One, with us responsible for their compliance. The same subsection confirms that we may transfer the Section 2 licenses to our successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets.
proposal.summary: Extend the Section 2 licences to Corio affiliates identified by written notice and confirm Corio may transfer them to its M&A successor.

mappings.element: Licence transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction.
